mechanism: Paroxetine inhibits CYP2C8 and CYP3A4, potentially increasing tretinoin levels; tretinoin is teratogenic and paroxetine is also associated with birth defects, creating compounded reproductive risk.
action: Use effective contraception; monitor for tretinoin toxicity signs (headache, visual changes, lipid elevation); consider alternative antidepressant if pregnancy planning; avoid in pregnancy.
